summary: Fox Factory Holding Corp. filed an 8-K disclosing a credit agreement amendment with Wells Fargo and other lenders. The amendment adjusts interest rate margins on term loans and revolving credit, tightens leverage ratio definitions, and imposes temporary restrictions on indebtedness, investments, and payments through June 2028. No stake, price, premium, or board recommendation is mentioned. This is a routine financing/credit-line adjustment, not a special situation. The filing lacks any acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or management change event.
